title: Keep one tagged-link sheet and a Monday check of what ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini say about Frequency
detail: Worksheet items 10 and 20. Mediums that land in the right channel: referral, social, email, video. Partner QR codes point at the /for page with tags, never /go or /q. First-touch records only after tracking consent, so counts are a floor. Steps and links: docs/marketing/off-site-seo-worksheet.md.

verify.evidence: Checked 2026-10-22: the first-touch cookie reads utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_content and utm_term (lib/attribution/first-touch.ts, confirmed by another thread).
